notes.title: v0.3143
notes.content:
We've had the last update a long time ago, so this is a big one!


 Two new WIP mechanics!
 6 new WIP cells!
 2 WIP minigames! Find them in the Passage levels.
 Introduced WIP Passage levels for all biomes.
 New Respawn Symbol effect!
 No more invisible walls! Feel free to jump to your death and restart the level.
 A huge amount of tweaks, features, bugfixes everywhere, too many to detail.


We're using the "WIP" word quite some in this update - it's only to remind you that none of these are production-ready and might feel prototype-ish here and there; we'd love your feedback so that we can improve them!

notes.title: v0.2924
notes.content:
Native Linux build on Steam (experimental)!
 Cell 34: Make the second part more comfortable to execute.
 Cell Editor: Asynchronous cell loading.
 Cell Editor: Lua Scripting reference now contains enums and BP classes.
 Cell Editor: Smaller gizmo and selection fixes.

notes.title: v0.2906
notes.content:
Add flashlight toggling.
 Cell Editor: Add support for external .lua files, including full IDE support with an EmmyLua annotated API reference.
 Slightly decrease hitching in corridors when we're loading the next level.
 Allow players to step on a stack of magnets (previous the stack has crumbled).
 Add a Look Around input hint while a button is being held.
 No more Texture Streaming pop-in when exiting the Portal.
 Input Binding improvements:

   Add a second column of bindings to the Controls menu;
   Add support for unbinding keys from the menu;
   Have both C and Ctrl work for Crouch as default.

 Cell 34: Redesign the second part in an attempt to make the solution more intuitive to find.
 Cell 31: Change level geometry to make the Fan part a bit more intuitive to solve.
 Cell 31: Fix cheating through the Fans by positioning the carried magnet in an unexpected way.
 Cell 26: Fix cheating through the Platform by jumping onto its very tiny edge and walk out crouching.
 And a dozen smaller improvements.

notes.title: v0.2873
notes.content:
This update brings the following changes:


 Crouching (introduced in the beginning of the game).
 Sphere Magnets are now more stable: They can rest on a magnet with an opposite polarity and they stop when they become too slow.
 Add Intel XeSS (1.1) support.
 DLSS is updated to SDK 3.1.10.
 Add an Unlimited FPS option (to be used with v-sync).
 Walking into the air of a Fan is now smoother.
 Cell Editor now supports selection "painting" by holding Shift.
 Volumes in Cell Editor now support selecting objects while the camera is inside them.
 Add a slow walking option to keyboards (holding Left Shift).
 It's not possible anymore to jump up to ledges from Sphere Magnets in an edge case.
 There's now an input tutorial that explains that the camera can be controlled while holding a button.
 Fix light color in Cell 6 that made the button color less visible.
 Cell 7 cannot be cheated anymore with an unplanned solution.
 Cell 8 now closes off the first part of the cell when the player reaches the second one.
 Cell 9 now has a more obvious way of bringing magnets back to their original area.
 In Cell 14 there are no more air particles visible at the back of the Fan.
 Some Decompositor Matter in Cell 15 has been turned into Force Fields so that misplacing a magnet a bit won't result in it being respawned.
 In Cell 17 the Force Fields are now clearly visible from the button.
 The first magnet in Cell 21 now has a longer timer, and the visibility of this and the exit door is improved.
 Cell 23 cannot be solved anymore by balancing a sphere magnet.
 Removed the entry tutorial area of Cell 25 and instead introduced a hint that explains Platform blocking.
 Exit door in Cell 26 is now visible from the button.
 Cell 31 is now more easily solvable without magnet juggling, lasers are avoidable while walking, and the connection between the Platform and the Fans should have higher visibility.
 Patch in the entrances of cells 32, 33 and 34 (where it was possible to walk out of the cell).
 Cell 34 now has up/down buttons (instead of left/right) on the platform, and the visibility of the laser at the top is increased.
 And dozens of other bug fixes / little changes.

notes.title: v0.2794
notes.content:
Hey,

we have polished a lot of stuff in this update, including:


 Updated game logo in the Main Menu.
 Upgraded FSR to 2.2.
 Changed and added some Voice-Overs.
 Hands (hopefully) can no longer get frozen when you bump into some objects (usually staircases).
 Unstable magnets now fall down instead of the player sliding on them.
 Frozen Magnets are now pushed away when a Force Field closes on them.
 Fix the camera might look in the wrong direction after the intro sequence.
 Fix you could still hover buttons in the menu while it was fading out.
 Flipped button in Cell 7 now has increased visibility.
 It's now harder to fail the second part of Cell 8.
 Disable Cell 18 and Cell 19 for now, as their quality do not match our targets.
 Removed the timing part of Cell 20.
 The first part of Cell 21 now tries to teach the new mechanic in a more obvious way.
 Cell 30 should now give less options for attempting to solve it in a wrong way.
 Decrease potential confusion in Cell 34.
 And a lot of smaller, unlisted fixes.

notes.title: v0.2732
notes.content:
Hey,

we have squashed some bugs and added some Cell Editor features, let us know if we accidentally introduced anything unwanted!


 Lift Intro cell now has an extended first part which teaches an important mechanic
 There's now a hint for the second part of Freeze Magnet Intro
 The green goo does not limit player jump height anymore
 The first Explosive Magnet in cell 21 now has a decreased timer
 Fix Volumetric Fog on Vulkan
 Cell Editor:
    
     Fix missing Message Log
     Volumes can now be configured to affect only the player, only magnets, or both
     Triggers can now be multi-use
     Scripting: Delegates can be unbound now by setting them to `nil`
     Scripting: Fix scripts were saveable / editable in stock cells (they shouldn't be)
     Scripting: `print` now works and writes to the Message Log (good for debugging)

notes.title: v0.2720
notes.content:
Hey,

we've just released a patch with the following changes:


 Fixed secret item achievements couldn't progress above 1 found item. To fix your progression, just pick up any item of that type, and the progress / unlock should be granted. For crystals, progression will indicate a total number of 6 items, but you'll get the achievement nevertheless when you find all currently in the game (4).
 Reworked PlayStation controller icons to be consistent with the ones of Xbox and Switch.
 Fixed the entrance of transition level between cells 2 and 3 was overlapping with some stones of the environment.
 Fixed the crystal unlock icon of cell 21 might have not been correctly marked as found in the Replay Cell List.
 We have moved a relic to a different cell. If you have found it previously, you'll still have it unlocked.
 Cell Editor: Added support for emitter-less Force Fields.
 Cell Editor: Fixed magnet with anti-gravity applied didn't lose this property when re-spawning.


Let us know if you have any feedback (or if we broke something)!
